svg.title: Cutaway diagram of the KLOT WSR-88D weather radar
svg.desc: A labeled cross-section of the Romeoville, Illinois NEXRAD installation: a fiberglass radome on a fixed steel tower enclosing an 8.5 meter S-band parabolic dish on an azimuth-elevation pedestal, above a ground-level equipment shelter containing the klystron transmitter, receiver, and signal processor.
